column1: # The load-bearing pair is `real-runs` and `mentions-only`. They differ in exactly one
# respect: whether the tools actually ran. `mentions-only` names every fuzzer, solver
# and scanner in an arsenal table and a dispatch plan, exactly as a real campaign brief
# does, and must score MISSED across the board. `real-runs` contains captured output
# from the same tools and must score USED at tier 1.
# `real-runs` also asserts MISSED for two techniques it genuinely did not exercise.
# An extractor that reports everything used and one that reports nothing used both
# print confidently; only a fixture that demands BOTH answers at once separates them.
